Right knee pain. R/O ACL insufficiency. 
MRI of right knee without contrast. 
Pulse sequences: sagittal T1, axial, coronal, sagittal T2 FS, sagittal PD FS

Findings: 
1. Suggestive of complete tear of ACL. 
The PCL appears intact. 
2. Tear of the posterior horn of medial meniscus.
The lateral meniscus shows no obvious tear. Suspected meniscocapsular separation over posterior horn of lateral meniscus. 
3. The medial & lateral collateral ligaments, quadriceps & patellar tendons show intact appearance. 
4. Mild to moderate knee joint effusion. 
5. Bone marrow edema over lateral tibial plateau. 
Periarticular & intraarticular soft tissue edema mainly over prepatellar & infrapatellar area. 
6. Intact patellar cartilage. 

IMP:
Complete ACL tear. 
Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus. 
Suspected meniscocapsular separation over posterior horn of lateral meniscus. 
Mild to moderate knee joint effusion. 
Bone marrow edema over lateral tibial plateau.

Suggest clinical correlation and further management.
